name: writing-library
description: My Writing: Allison's private, read-only reading app for her poems and other writing.

scripts.lint: eslint app.ts lib tests playwright.config.ts sw.js
scripts.format: prettier --write app.ts sw.js styles.css index.html manifest.webmanifest lib tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json README.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app.ts sw.js styles.css index.html manifest.webmanifest lib tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json README.md .github
